modal_download_hint: Video opens in new tab → Right-click Save As (.mp4), then set as wallpaper
tutorial_general_tip: 💡 General method: Save video to gallery → Open in Photos → tap More → Set as Wallpaper → Live Wallpaper → Confirm.
tutorial_ios18_steps: Open video on X, long-press → Save to Photos
Open Settings → Wallpaper → Add New Wallpaper
Select Live Wallpaper → pick video from Photos
tutorial_ios16_steps: Download IntoLive app (free on App Store)
Save video to Photos → open in IntoLive
Long-press home screen → choose wallpaper → pick Live Photo
tutorial_android_steps: Save video to gallery (long-press on X → Save)
Open Gallery → find video → tap menu
Select Set as Wallpaper → Live Wallpaper / Video Wallpaper
tutorial_samsung_steps: Install Good Lock → add Wonderland plugin
Or: Settings → Wallpaper and Style → More wallpapers → Live Wallpaper
Select Video Wallpaper → pick from gallery
tutorial_huawei_steps: Settings → Wallpaper & Personalization → Wallpaper → Live Wallpaper
Tap More → pick video from gallery
tutorial_xiaomi_steps: Open video in gallery → tap More → Set as Wallpaper
Or: Settings → Wallpaper → Live Wallpaper → pick from gallery
tutorial_oppo_steps: Settings → Wallpaper & Personalization → Wallpaper → Live Wallpaper
Select Video Wallpaper → pick from gallery
tutorial_vivo_steps: Open iTheme app → My → Wallpaper → Live Wallpaper
Select Custom → pick video from gallery
tutorial_pixel_steps: Select Live Wallpaper → pick from gallery
tutorial_warning_ratio: ⚠️ Aspect ratio mismatch: wallpaper will be cropped. Use the ratio filter to find wallpapers matching your phone's screen.
tutorial_warning_sound: ⚠️ Video plays without sound: live wallpapers are muted by design.
tutorial_tip_duration: 🔄 6-10 second short loop videos work best for wallpapers.
tutorial_footer:
Live Wallpaper 4 Phone — Curating the best mobile live wallpapers from X
Setup methods may vary by OS version. Always refer to your device.
tutorial_app_intolive_desc: Free on App Store. Converts videos to Live Photos, supports trimming and speed adjustment.
tutorial_app_wallpaper_engine_desc: Paid on App Store. Supports looping video wallpapers, management, and scheduled switching.
tutorial_tip_samsung: 💡 Samsung One UI 6+ natively supports video wallpapers — no third-party app needed.
tutorial_tip_huawei: 💡 Some models need to set via Theme app: Theme → My → Mix & Match → Wallpaper → Live Wallpaper.
tutorial_tip_xiaomi: 💡 MIUI 14+ has native video wallpaper support. HyperOS supports separate lock screen and home screen wallpapers.
